name: Ratatosk
body:
RATATOSK
CR 4

The chattering squirrel creature has tiny tusks and fur that shimmers in a way that defies the surrounding light.

XP 1,200
CN Tiny outsider (extraplanar)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +10

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 16, flat-footed 14 (+4 Dex, +2 natural, +2 size)
hp 33 (6d10)
Fort +2, Ref +9, Will +6
Defensive Abilities DR 5/cold iron and lawful; Immune cold, disease, poison; Resist fire 5; SR 17

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee bite +12 (1d3-3), gore +12 (1d4-3)
Space 2.5 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks annoying chitter (DC 17), divisive chitter (DC 17)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +20)

At Will—animal messenger, message
3/day—sending, suggestion
1/day—commune (as a standard action)

STATISTICS

Str 4, Dex 19, Con 10, Int 17, Wis 12, Cha 18
Base Atk +6; CMB +15 (+19 grapple); CMD 29 (can’t be tripped)
Feats Deceitful, Improved Initiative, Weapon Finesse, 1 feat left
Skills Bluff +15, Climb +13, Diplomacy +13, Disguise +6 (+10 to disguise itself as an ordinary squirrel), Knowledge (local) +9, Knowledge (planes) +12, Linguistics +12, Perception +10, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +13
Languages Abyssal, Celestial, Common, Protean, telepathy (100 ft.) + 6 other languages that would be helpful for where they bring messages
SQ desperate lies, skitter

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Annoying Chitter (Su)

As a swift action, a ratatosk chitter loudly, dealing 6d6 sonic damage (DC 17 Fortitude half ) to one creature it can see within 60 feet. A creature failing its save is also sickened for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Desperate Lies (Su)

When the ratatosk is targeted with an attack, as an immediate action they can spout lies while pointing out another target, redirecting their attack against another creature of the ratatosk’s choice as murderous command (DC 17 Will negates). This is a mind-affecting compulsion. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Divisive Chitter (Su)

A ratatosk can inspire unrest in all creatures of its choice within 30 feet, causing them to become fascinated (DC 17 Will negates) for as long as ratatosk continues chittering and for 1d6 rounds thereafter. The fascinated creatures spend their time arguing with others around them rather than focusing on the ratatosk, and has no effect if only one creature is within range. This is a mind-affecting auditory compulsion. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Skitter (Ex)

As a swift action, a ratatosk can use the withdraw action, moving up to its speed.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

The ratatosk is a celestial being that is very much convinced of its own indispensable place in the multiverse, delivering messages from the celestial realms to the fiendish pits and chattering amiably with creatures all along its route. It is equally happy to carry casual insults and imprecations as important communiques, so long as its vanity is stroked and its wit amused. Its fur is sleek, and it takes great pride in the cleaning and maintenance of its tiny tusks.
